purpose: Records which ground-truth facts each description states, so that 'explicit' vs 'retrieved' vs 'inferred' can be judged and extraction is not confused with discovery. Not shown to any extraction method.
design_principles: Same underlying problem and same ground truth for both variants.
No formulas, no mapping of parameters to objectives in either variant.
The complete variant names every physical quantity the implementation uses, with its value, but leaves it to the reader to decide which objective needs which quantity.
The incomplete variant names only the decision variables and the two objectives.

facts.fact: Four decision variables = cross-sectional areas of four bars
Objective 2 = minimize displacement of a particular joint
Allowable stress sigma = 10 kN/cm^2, which with F sets the minimum area; upper bound = 3x minimum
Volume expression L*(2x1 + sqrt(2)x2 + sqrt(x3) + x4)
facts.complete: NOT stated (only that volume is minimized)

facts.fact: Individual bounds: x1,x4 in [a,3a]; x2,x3 in [sqrt(2)a,3a]
facts.complete: PARTIALLY stated (common minimum + 3x upper bound; the sqrt(2) lower bound for x2,x3 is not stated)

known_simplifications: 'Characteristic bar length' is used because the implementation has a single length L; it does not say that all four bars have length L.
'Statically loaded' and 'single external force' are engineering context consistent with the formulation, not stated in DESDEO source.
The truss geometry (bar arrangement, angles) is not described in either variant; the source of the sqrt(2) coefficients is therefore not stated.
